effects.display_name: Random Termite native one-shot replacement and conditional native goals

Inclusive1..2==2 -> one server Worker; else NEW inclusive1..2==2 and three exact original positive-X/Z clearance blocks empty -> one server Soldier; else one server Alate. These are two distinct conditional RNG consumers, not a single uniform three-species roll. Each child original XYZ/MOB_SUMMONED/zeroMotion with no owner assignment. Later done=true prevents repeated replacement. Actor still declares native retaliation, melee speed1.2/nativeclock/LOS/strict squared distance<(selfWidth²+targetWidth), attack attribute3. Those goals remain conditional on native AI/target/lifecycle; do not invent a custom attack, guaranteed lifetime or guaranteed callback exit from discard. No local hurt override or custom saved-state/dimensions. Local ON_GROUND/MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES replacement placement delegates RandomSpawnConfig; material registry reachability stays setup queue. Child intrinsic combat families reference this producer without duplicate intrinsic payloads.

effects.display_name: Termite Alate native flight, delayed vector writes and melee
effects.actual_behavior: Monster AI enabled; only Avoid Ant Soldier/MoveBackToVillage/wander/look custom wrappers require native onGround, not Player/Ant prey/retaliation/melee goals. Melee attack3/knockback.2, speed1.2, clock/strict squared distance<4/LOS. Expired termitetick resets inclusive200..600 and toggles flymode, else-1. Flymode true writes noGravity=true; boost<=0 resets20. No current target: random idle independent X/Z[-.6,.6), Y[-.6,.9); queues10 captured SELF then horizontal current yaw+90 /2 preserving current Y. With current target: faces it, immediately writes horizontal-only normalized target delta /2 preserving Y, with no zero-distance guard; queues17 captured SELF then independent random X/Z[-.2,.2),Y[-.8,1). Immediate target-height branch afterwards adds+.4 or-.4 to current Y, preserving current XZ. Delayed writes do not recheck flymode, target, level, alive or owner; flymode false only disables gravity and does not cancel queued vectors or clear previous velocity. Positive boost decrements only while flying. Absolute velocity is not vanilla knockback. Direct AbstractArrow excludes before potion/cloud/Poison, FALL and CACTUS, then parent; no custom damage/status in flight helper. Fixed scale.96, texture NBT and native removal10 retained.

effects.display_name: Termite Queen native summon cadence, regeneration and fatigue flag writer
effects.actual_behavior: Monster constructor explicitly NoAI=true and persistence required; no local registerGoals override, nonpushable, far-distance removal false. Unused ATTACK_DAMAGE9 does not create an attack scalar. Each callback additionally requests actor-bound data merge NoAI:1 at permission4; ignored command result is not a new guaranteed admission rule. Server SELF Regen60/1 every callback. Player present in original full-side50 gates summon clock: expired and not inside wall, if King absent original full-side100 -> one server King, else one server RandomTermite, at original XYZ/MOB_SUMMONED/zeroMotion/no owner assignment. Resets inclusive200..800 even inside wall/nonserver/failed spawn; positive clock-1 only with nearby Player, so absence stalls it. Hard-coded single calls are not scalar burst counts. First raw angled=false uses ordered mound diagonal±2X/±2Z sameY tests then latches and faces opposite direction; ordinary fixed pose, not an additional attack. Separately Player present original full-side100 and independently nearest Player100 without Mining Fatigue -> writes/syncs recipient PlayerVariables.totemfatigue=true. THIS helper does not add Mining Fatigue or write raw queenslowtotem. Locked global Mining Fatigue consumer reads a DISTINCT raw queenslowtotem flag; no unproved direct alias/bridge between those flags is asserted. Attachment transport/consumer remains exact finite state queue. Native die calls parent first then helper: difficulty not PEACEFUL -> server one unowned King at CURRENT dying SELF XYZ/zeroMotion; queues2 using original world/XYZ and at delivery King presence full-side30 then independently nearest King30 receives DATA_larvae=true. Can mark an old/unrelated King rather than the spawned reference; no owner, alive or current Queen identity recheck. No death helper on mere discard. Direct potion/cloud/Poison, FALL and CACTUS admission retained; fixed physical1.4 and texture-only NBT, native death removal100. Native regen, summon and state delivery remain distinct.

effects.display_name: Termite Worker native tunneling control, target selection and melee
effects.actual_behavior: Monster, not TamableAnimal; native attack3/knockback.2, melee speed1.2/clock/strict squared distance<2.25/LOS. Avoid Ant Soldier, target Player and Ant Worker/Queen/base Ant; retaliation alone wraps parent admission with locked CheckOwned on current target, not every target goal. Tick writes climbradius.95. Independent inclusive0..300==1 toggles current arphexclimber; shared climbing reader reused. Entry tunneling true: current block hardness>=5 clears flag but remaining entry branch still executes; empty current block teleports SELF down1, then noPhysics=true/noGravity=true/sprint=true. Entry false resets both physics/gravity, sprint false and conditional crouch. Only afterwards expired termitetick toggles current flag and resets either1200..2400 when disabling or100..250 when enabling; else decrements1. Thus physics writes use entry state, later motion uses updated state. Expired reversefromsolid snapshots current XYZ and resets10, else decrements1; snapshot is a real backward-motion input, not ownership/progression. Targetless entry: first Ant Queen in original full-side50 is assigned; else nearest Player50 only when that player creativespectator flag is false. This branch then forces tunneling=true/Y.2 inside wall, else false, even when it just assigned a target; targeted branch does not run in the same callback. Targeted entry independently finds nearest Worker in target-centered full-side10; if that Worker is outside wall, clears THAT Worker tunneling flag (can be another actor). Updated self tunneling true and boost<=0 resets20 and faces current target. If current and six axial blocks all have hardness<5, writes horizontal-only normalized target direction /12, preserving Y, with no zero-distance guard. Otherwise nonzero snapshot XZ delta writes backward horizontal normalized direction /8; only snapshot X/Y/Z all nonzero writes Y+.2 or-.2 by snapshot height. Then current target condition overwrites Y+.2 only when self below target and current/aboveY1/aboveY2 are all occupied, else-.2. Positive boost decrements only in the targeted+tunneling branch. No block breaking occurs here, and no MobGriefing/config guard is invented. Worker hurt calls the locked Ant Worker inside-wall Instant Health helper BEFORE potion/cloud/Poison, FALL and CACTUS filters; its single native amplifier consumer is reused, not duplicated. Physical scale.8 and texture-only local NBT; no source-owned tunnel or custom knockback.
